title: [PS5] Death Stranding Director’s Cut Digital Deluxe Edition $9.49 @ PlayStation
body:
Deal: [PS5] Death Stranding Director’s Cut Digital Deluxe Edition $9.49 @ PlayStation

[bargainatoraah] Wait, what? Is this an apology to Kojima? Or perhaps the opposite..
[kungfuman] I have this game on every platform, PC, Mac OS, iOS steamOS, PS5 and i still don't play it lol.
[bargainatoraah] They really need to merge iOS and Mac OS os
[firedolphin] hang on, what? some context please, i just bought a game on PSN…..
[trustnoone] I think this is related to the recent PS5 hack, where people are playing games in not the most legal ways.
[firedolphin] ah okay, thanks, I thought it's about Sony can digitally take the games off my library even if I bought them…
[cook99] @firedolphin: Oh they can and will do that eventually too. "A reasonable user would expect a digital purchase is only a limited undetermined period rental". Sony… Probably
[firedolphin] @cook99: okay, i guess I'm an unreasonable person then 🙄
[TruckTrespass] @firedolphin: And not probably, that's almost word for word what they said: "In the digital age, it is not plausible to allege that reasonable consumers believed they were obtaining ‘ownership’ of a digital game" - actually Sony
[cook99] Nice try Sorny, I'm not updating beyond 13.6
[Porker] Sony's dynamic pricing at play?
Show's up as $9.49 for me
[deadpoet] PSPrices confirms $9.49
https://psprices.com/region-au/game/4713715/death-stranding-…
[londonjustin] yep - showing 47.47 for me when logged it. Once I log out it goes to 9.49 .. what the …?
[sween64] Showing is $9.49 for me when logged in. I don’t have PS+.
[Porker] I thought Sony was introducing dynamic pricing. Basically the more games you buy, they higher prices will be for you.
[cmoddoo] What is the upgrade price if I have the PS4 copy?
[cmoddoo] I don't want to remove the shrinkwrap off my copy to find out….
[xcess] If only they had AI that can answer questions
[cmoddoo] Gemini says still $20 for the PS4 to PS5 upgrade but I have no idea if its accurate. For that price might as well buy this and sell the unused copy on marketplace
[Gabrieltn] Finished this one (on PC) earlier this year and have not been able to stop recommending it. No-brainer at this price! Takes a little while to get into but is so worth it.
[Gabrieltn] I mean… I guess? The game simulates walking, and the walking is the main action, yes. There’s a lot more to the game than just walking, and there are more types of travel, too.
[BoltThrower] More than that; A man who refuses to make two trips and carries 8 shopping bags at once.
[maverickjohn] This game definitely is encouraged to try a demo. I couldn't stand it. I've played for 38 or so hours and it was a torturous 38 hours.. I think if it doesn't click with you in the 1st 2-4 hours, it's likely that it won't for the rest.
[SeanConnery] Did it have any good boss fights in those hours you played?
Is it the type of game that lets you speedrun the boring parts to get to the boss fights?
[Gabrieltn] The boss fights are one of the weaker aspects of the game. If you’re not into the “boring bits”, you won’t like it - there’s no Death Stranding without occasionally spending 30 minutes walking from point A to point B.
[sween64] Arduous travel and complex inventory management. Doesn’t sound like it’s for me.
